title: App Shell
description: The frame of a signed-in app, composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Drawer, Menu, Avatar, Button, Alert and Skeleton primitives: a sidebar with the product name and the main navigation, a top bar with the page heading and an account Menu, and the page's content beside them; the content has its own loading, error and empty renders; responds to its container (@container) — below @md the sidebar collapses into a left Drawer opened from a Menu button in the top bar, the account trigger shows the user's name from @sm, and the sidebar widens and the content gains room at @lg.
